title: 2023 Panini Prizm Draft Picks - Fearless Green Prizm #F-12 Devon Witherspoon...
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2023 Panini Prizm Draft Picks card features Devon Witherspoon of the Illinois Fighting Illini. The card is a Green Prizm parallel/variety, with a card number of F-12. It is part of the Fearless insert set and is a rookie card for football fans. 

The card is perfect for collectors and enthusiasts of the National Collegiate Athletic Association (NCAA) and sports trading cards. Manufactured by Panini, it has several features including an insert set, parallel/variety, and the player's name and team. This card is a great addition to any collection and is perfect for football fans who want to add a unique and rare card to their collection.
